title: IIT Gandhinagar Summer Research Internship Programme (SRIP) 2027
summary: At least eight weeks of on-campus research with IIT Gandhinagar faculty across engineering, sciences, humanities and design.
eligibility: Students pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree at a prominent Indian institution, with a strong academic record and a statement of purpose matched to a listed project.

prize.description: ₹2,000 per week (₹16,000 for 8 weeks) plus free hostel accommodation; top performers can win the ₹50,000 Bhalodia-Khetan Excellence Award.

notes: The 2026 edition ran 7 May–16 July 2026; applications usually open in January–February.
